caption: Figure 7.5: Leontovich Surface Impedance Boundary Condition (use_sibc=True). Left: at RF and microwave frequencies (f ~ 0.1–30 GHz), good conductors such as copper (σ = 5.8×10⁷ S/m) have a skin depth δ = √(2/(ωμσ)) ~ 0.4–6 μm that is orders of magnitude smaller than a millimeter-scale cavity mesh cell. Right: when use_sibc=True, Wakis checks whether δ at fmax is smaller than the grid cell size and replaces volumetric bulk conductivity with the Leontovich SIBC on the conductor surface.
visual_intent:
Textbook-quality scientific schematic for a computational electromagnetics user manual. Flat vector style on a white background, high contrast, thin dark outlines, generous whitespace, sans-serif labels. Colour code used in every figure: primary grid G and its quantities in blue, dual grid G-tilde and its quantities in orange, exact/topological items in dark grey, approximate/material items in green, failure or warning items in red. Colourblind-safe. Every label must be spelled exactly as listed in this brief; mathematical symbols must be typeset correctly (hats, tildes, subscripts, transposes). Do not add any number, value, equation, software name, product name, logo, watermark or title that is not listed in this brief. Prefer fewer, larger labels over many small ones. No 3D photorealism, no cartoon characters, no hand-drawn or xkcd style.

Two panels side by side. LEFT PANEL (red warning border, heading 'Scale mismatch: skin depth δ vs millimeter grid cell'): draw a 2D cross-section of a vacuum cavity cell of size labelled 'grid cell Δ_min (~ mm)' meeting a shaded metallic wall labelled 'copper: σ = 5.8×10⁷ S/m,  f ~ 0.1–30 GHz'. A magnifying-glass inset at the metal surface shows the exponentially decaying field profile inside the metal over a microscopic layer labelled 'skin depth δ = √(2 / (ωμσ)) ~ 0.4–6 μm', with a red warning badge 'δ ≪ Δ_min: volumetric mesh cannot resolve skin layer'. RIGHT PANEL (green border, heading 'Leontovich SIBC: SolverFIT3D(..., use_sibc=True, fmax=1e9)'): top half shows a decision diamond containing the exact check from line 1484: 'sigma > 2 / (mu * delta_min^2 * 2*pi*fmax)  (δ(fmax) < Δ_min)'. An arrow 'True' leads to the bottom drawing of the cavity-conductor interface where the bulk metal interior is hatched grey ('no volumetric bulk conductivity stepping') and the boundary face between vacuum and metal is highlighted with a thick green bar labelled 'Leontovich Surface Impedance Boundary Condition (SIBC) applied on conductor surface'.
